msg_engine_warming_no_build: (engine loading/warming up — voice template build unavailable)

msg_update_available: New version v{ver} available - get it from the download page
msg_warn_font_missing: ⚠ Chinese font not found on this system; UI text may show as boxes — contact the developer for a build with bundled fonts.
msg_warn_no_enabled: ⚠ No command enabled yet — recognition will produce no output. Add a command on the Commands tab and build its voice template.
msg_warn_no_mic: ⚠ No microphone input detected — check system microphone permission / device selection
ui_hint_app_tagline: Continuous voice-command-to-key tool. Speak a word, press a key.
ui_hint_disclaimer_keys: Input-mapping tool: follow the target game's terms of service — account risk is yours. Sends standard keyboard events only; no memory reading, no injection.
ui_hint_sv_model_missing: Speaker model missing; speaker verification is unavailable
ui_hint_gate_manual_start: manual gate is the starting point
ui_hint_macro_text_rules:
One action per line: d/u/p/w + key or ms (or down/up/press/wait)
# starts a comment
ui_hint_min_confidence: Too many false triggers → raise; no triggers → lower
ui_hint_multi: Checked: match on multiple nuclei (waits for all of them - steadier, slower). Unchecked: single nucleus (fires on the first one - faster). Default is derived from your recordings and can be overridden.
ui_hint_mutex: Tick the commands that are mutually exclusive with this one: triggering one releases the keys held by the others.
ui_hint_no_enabled_cmds: No commands enabled yet — go to the Commands tab and tap "＋ New command" to add one.
ui_hint_no_recs: No recordings yet — click "Record" and say it 3-5 times
ui_hint_noise_model: Use the noise-robust encoder (steadier in noise, slightly worse in quiet). After switching, restart Yuke and templates rebuild automatically.
ui_hint_privacy_local: Recordings and settings stay on this machine, encrypted. The only network access is checking for updates.
ui_hint_reentry_ignore: Ignore new triggers while the previous instance is running
ui_hint_reentry_interrupt: A new trigger interrupts the old instance (its held keys are released in reverse order)
ui_hint_responsiveness: Faster feels snappier; slower is more accurate. Restart to apply; templates rebuild automatically.
ui_hint_tap: Presses the key once on trigger
ui_hint_toggle_press: Press on trigger, release on the next trigger
ui_hint_voice_toggle: Say this command = toggle the global key switch
